response.sql: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT P.ID AS ID, P.SEX AS SEX, AVG(L.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(L.IGA - L.IGM) AS avg_diff FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS overall_mean FROM per_patient), with_ratio AS (SELECT pp.ID, pp.SEX, pp.avg_pt, pp.avg_diff, pp.avg_diff / o.overall_mean AS ratio FROM per_patient pp CROSS JOIN overall o) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(avg_diff) AS avg_iga_igm_diff, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM with_ratio GROUP BY SEX
